Description: Plant holders. Lip 52.8mm / base 30.5mm / height 50.3mm
Why I need it: Every socket in the tower is cut to this pot's taper. Change the pot and all 4 modules need a respin
Notes: Have 1 sample measured with calipers. Drives all socket geometry. Need 16 plus spares

Description: Nutrient tank. 302mm OD x 368mm tall / 18.9 L
Why I need it: Holds the 18.9 L the tower recirculates. No reservoir means no loop
Notes: Standard Homer Bucket

Description: 550 GPH / 2.2m max lift / 30W / 120V AC
Why I need it: The only thing in the build that moves water. Everything after it is gravity
Notes: 1/2in NPT female outlet

Description: Pump outlet to PVC
Why I need it: Pump outlet is threaded and the pipe is slip. Nothing connects without it
Notes: Charlotte PVC021090600HD. Lost the original

Description: Supply pipe up the tower. 21.34mm OD
Why I need it: Carries water from the pump to the top of the tower in one unbroken run
Notes: One continuous length. about 1.05m cut from the 10ft stock

Item: PVC bypass tee / ball valve / fittings
Description: Sheds excess pump flow back to the tank
Why I need it: The pump makes roughly 10x the flow the tower wants. Without the bypass it pushes against a closed line and cooks itself
Notes: No union. the pipe stays glued to the pump and comes out with it

Description: Pipe pass-through in the tank lid plate
Why I need it: Watertight pass-through where the pipe crosses the tank lid. Otherwise the tank is open around the pipe

Description: Screw-on bucket lid. Printed plate mounts in the centre opening
Why I need it: Gives the bucket a screw-on lid that the printed tank plate can mount into
Notes: Measure centre opening on arrival

Description: Water level. Non-contact. Also detects pump failure via level rise
Why I need it: Tank level. Doubles as pump failure detection. An unexplained level rise means the tower drained back
Notes: Mounted in the tank lid plate

Description: Water temperature
Why I need it: Water temperature. Warm solution loses dissolved oxygen and bare roots rot fast
Notes: 1-Wire

Description: Air temperature and humidity
Why I need it: Air temp and humidity. Tells me whether the grow space is drying the leaves out or too humid
Notes: I2C

Description: LED strip switching and PWM dimming
Why I need it: The pi cannot switch 24 V. This is what turns the lights on and dims them
Notes: Drives the led strip

Description: Grow lighting on the four corner rails
Why I need it: Indoor tower with no sun on it. Without light nothing grows at all
Notes: ~60W total for 16 plants

Description: Thermal path for the LED strip. Not optional
Why I need it: Heatsinks the strip. Bare led tape on plastic cooks itself and dims within months
Notes: One per corner post

Description: LED strip power
Why I need it: Powers the led strip and feeds the dosing pumps through the buck converter

Description: External cable rail wiring
Why I need it: Wet environment. Lets me unplug a sensor instead of cutting it out of the loom

Description: Passive leak containment under the whole assembly
Why I need it: Passive leak containment. The only safety layer still working when software sensors and plumbing have all failed
Notes: Required not optional. Indoor floor

Description: Module-to-module bolted joints
Why I need it: Gives printed plastic a real metal thread. Bolting straight into pla strips the hole out
Notes: 4 per joint

Description: Module-to-module bolted joints
Why I need it: Clamps the modules to each other. 4 per joint

Description: Seed starting. Must clear the 48mm pot mouth
Why I need it: Seeds need somewhere to germinate before they can go into a net pot
Notes: Consumable

Description: Nutrient solution
Why I need it: Bare roots in plain water starve. This is the actual food
Notes: Consumable

Description: Nutrient pH. BNC electrode with signal conditioning board
Why I need it: Nutrients only dissolve in a narrow ph band. Outside it plants starve while sitting in full solution
Notes: Probe is a wear item. Needs calibration solution

Description: Nutrient strength. Tells me when to top up nutrients
Why I need it: Nutrient strength so I know when to top up. Also confirms a dose actually landed in the tank
Notes: Cross-talks with the pH probe unless isolated

Item: pH and EC calibration solution set
Description: pH 4.0 and 7.0 buffers plus 1413uS EC standard
Why I need it: An uncalibrated probe reads confident nonsense. Also my check that the probe is still honest
Notes: Required not optional. Probes drift and must be recalibrated

Description: Clean analog reads for the pH and EC boards
Why I need it: The pi has no analog input at all. Without this ph and ec simply cannot be read
Notes: Mandatory. The pi has no analog input at all

Description: Doses nutrient A / nutrient B / pH down
Why I need it: Doses nutrient a nutrient b and ph down without me standing there with a measuring cup
Notes: Mounts on the bottle cap. Only the intake tube goes inside

Description: Drives the three dosing pumps
Why I need it: The pi cannot drive 12 V pumps directly. This is the switch between them
Notes: Existing single MOSFET is committed to the LED strip

Description: Replacement tubing for the dosers
Why I need it: The rollers flatten the tube and dose accuracy drifts. Wear item not an optional spare
Notes: Wear item. Tubing flattens and loses accuracy

Description: Concentrate reservoirs. One per dosing channel
Why I need it: Holds each concentrate. The cap carries the pump intake tube and a vent hole
Notes: Cap carries the pump intake tube and a vent hole

Description: Steps the LED supply down for the dosing pumps
Why I need it: Dosing pumps are 12 V and the only supply in the build is 24 V
Notes: Dosing pumps are 12V. Only PSU in the build is 24V

Description: MQTT broker / SQLite / web dashboard
Why I need it: Runs everything. Broker control loop database dashboard and alerts
Notes: Already have it

Description: Mains safety. Pump is 120V AC next to standing water
Why I need it: A 120 V pump sits in an open tank of water. This is the only thing between that and a shock
Notes: Not optional. Skip only if the outlet is already GFCI

Description: Prototype parts and consumable root grates
Why I need it: Prototype parts and the root grates which are treated as consumable
Notes: Grates are treated as wear items

Description: Final structural parts. Water tolerant
Why I need it: Structural parts that live in water. Pla softens and creeps when wet and warm

Description: Lowers ph. Dosed automatically by the third pump
Why I need it: Ph drifts upward as the plants feed. This is what pulls it back
Notes: Consumable. This is the one that actually gets used

Description: Raises ph. Added by hand when needed
Why I need it: For when ph overshoots low. Rare enough that it does not get its own pump
Notes: Consumable. Too rarely needed to deserve a pump

Description: Custom raspberry pi hat. 2 layer
Why I need it: Everything between the pi and the tower lives on this board. The adc and every mosfet are on it
Notes: idk yet. fill this in once the board is finished and i have a real quote
